title: Roommate charged with two counts of murder in death, disappearance of two USF students
summary: Authorities have filed murder charges against the roommate of a Bangladeshi doctoral student who disappeared with his girlfriend from the University of South Florida.
contentText:
Authorities have filed murder charges against the roommate of a Bangladeshi doctoral student who disappeared with his girlfriend from the University of South Florida.

(Image credit: Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office)
